incidents.title: AI-agent-driven offensive operation: exposed adversary open directory targeting crypto wallets
incidents.confidenceReason: CloudSEK examined the operator's exposed open directory.
incidents.summary: An exposed open directory showed an operator running AI agents against crypto-wallet credentials, routing all agent traffic through a self-hosted proxy to Zhipu's GLM to cut cost and avoid abuse monitoring.
incidents.quote: LLM backend: Rather than the official model providers, the operator routes all agent traffic through a self-hosted proxy to a Chinese large language model (Zhipu GLM)
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only CloudSEK has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: JADEPUFFER evolves: agentic actor deploys ransomware built to destroy AI models
incidents.outcome: Ransomware built to destroy AI models was deployed in AI infrastructure.
incidents.confidenceReason: Sysdig: 'Our case for autonomous operation rested on concrete behavioral signals'. Behavioural inference, consistent with the June JadePuffer entry.
incidents.summary: In a follow-on to its June operation, the agentic actor JADEPUFFER entered AI infrastructure through an AI framework and deployed ransomware designed to destroy the models it hosts. The date is approximate.
incidents.quote: The entry point and the payload in this new operation tell the same story: an agentic operator enters AI infrastructure through an AI framework
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Sysdig has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

incidents.title: Attacker prompts an exposed agent app into revealing METR's API key
incidents.targets: METR (AI evaluation nonprofit), public-models API account
incidents.outcome: The key was used for three weeks; METR puts the free credits at about $600,000 and says no sensitive data was accessed.
incidents.confidenceReason: METR, the victim, described the incident; it reaches us through AI Threat Watch.
incidents.summary: A fail-open bug exposed a researcher's agent app to the internet; an attacker prompted an agent to reveal METR's API key and used it for three weeks.
incidents.quote: A fail-open bug in a researcher's AI-written agent app exposed it to the internet; an attacker prompted an agent to reveal METR's public-models API key and used it for three weeks.
incidents.singleSourceReason: This operation reaches the ledger only through AI Threat Watch's record; the 2026-11-17 sweep found no other publisher.

incidents.title: Joint advisory: actors use AI-generated exploitation scripts against internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs
incidents.targets: US-based Siemens S7-200/300/400/1200/1500 PLC installations; water and other critical infrastructure
incidents.outcome: Internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs had memory and ladder logic read and written.
incidents.confidenceReason: The FBI, CISA and NSA, government bodies, state the actors used AI-generated scripts.
incidents.summary: A joint advisory says actors used AI-generated Python scripts built on python-snap7, disguised as monitoring tools, to gain access to internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs and read and write memory and ladder logic.
incidents.quote: The threat actors are conducting reconnaissance and capability development against U.S.-based Siemens PLC installations using AI-generated exploitation scripts disguised as legitimate monitoring tools.
